# Shri Vishwavedhika Ayurvedic Clinic

> Authentic classical Ayurvedic clinic & Panchakarma centre in Kharadi, Pune, led by Dr. Manjiri Musmade (B.A.M.S., PGFC in Panchakarma).

Shri Vishwavedhika Ayurvedic Clinic provides root-cause classical Ayurvedic healing, Nadi Pariksha (pulse diagnosis), five-fold Panchakarma bio-purification, Garbha Sanskar antenatal care, and non-surgical spine and joint rehabilitation in Kharadi, Pune.

## Treatments & Protocols

- [Panchakarma Treatment](https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/panchakarma-treatment-in-kharadi): Authentic 5-fold bio-purification (Vamana, Virechana, Basti, Nasya, Raktamokshana) for deep metabolic toxin (Ama) eradication.
- [Kati Basti (Spine & Sciatica Care)](https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/kati-basti-treatment-in-kharadi): Non-surgical localized warm medicated oil reservoir therapy for slip disc, lumbar spondylosis, and sciatic nerve pain.
- [Janu Basti (Knee Joint Care)](https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/janu-basti-treatment-in-kharadi): Classical herbal oil retention therapy for knee osteoarthritis, crepitus, cartilage erosion, and avoiding knee replacement surgery.
- [Manya Basti (Cervical & Neck Care)](https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/manya-basti-treatment-in-kharadi): Targeted cervical spine oil pooling for cervical spondylosis, neck stiffness, brachial radiculopathy, and tech neck syndrome.
- [Shirodhara Therapy](https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/shirodhara-treatment-in-kharadi): Continuous warm herbal oil stream over the forehead (Ajna chakra) for clinical insomnia, work stress, anxiety, and migraines.
- [Garbha Sanskar Program](https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/garbha-sanskar-in-kharadi): Classical Vedic antenatal science, Beej Shuddhi preconception detox, Masanumasik Ahara diet, and Garbha Samvad for holistic fetal wellness.
- [Infertility & PCOD Treatment](https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/infertility-treatment-in-kharadi): Root-cause Ayurvedic fertility enhancement for PCOS/PCOD, ovulatory dysfunction, low AMH, and natural conception support.
- [Uttar Basti Therapy](https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/uttar-basti-treatment-in-kharadi): Specialized intrauterine medicated oil therapy for non-surgical fallopian tubal recanalization and uterine lining rejuvenation.
- [Stroke Rehabilitation](https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/stroke-rehabilitation-in-kharadi): Ayurvedic neuro-restorative protocol combining Njavarakizhi, Shirodhara, and Medhya Rasayanas for paralysis and hemiplegia recovery.
- [Vamana Therapy](https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/vamana-therapy-in-kharadi): Therapeutic medicated emesis for chronic asthma, allergic bronchitis, sinusitis, and severe Kapha imbalances.
- [Virechana Therapy](https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/virechana-therapy-in-kharadi): Targeted therapeutic purgation for liver detoxification, hyperacidity, chronic skin disorders, and Pitta metabolic cleansing.
- [Basti Treatment](https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/basti-treatment-in-kharadi): Medicated oil and herbal decoction enemas (Yoga, Kala, and Karma Basti regimens) addressing the master dosha Vata.
- [Nasya Therapy](https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/nasya-therapy-in-kharadi): Cranial administration of medicated herbal drops for chronic sinusitis, migraine, cervical stiffness, and hair fall.
- [Raktamokshana Therapy](https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/raktamokshana-treatment-in-kharadi): Classical blood purification using sterile surgical techniques and medical leeches for localized toxic Pitta and Rakta diseases.
- [Agnikarma Pain Treatment](https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/agnikarma-treatment-in-kharadi): Fast-acting micro-thermal cautery using a Panchadhatu Shalaka for instant relief in heel spurs, plantar fasciitis, and tennis elbow.
- [Jalaukavacharana Leech Therapy](https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/jalaukavacharana-leech-therapy-in-kharadi): Painless hirudotherapy with live medicinal leeches to clear venous pooling, varicose veins, chronic eczema, and localized thrombosis.
- [Takradhara & Lepa Therapy](https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/takradhara-treatment-in-kharadi): Cooling medicated buttermilk stream and classical herbal paste application for psoriasis, eczema, alopecia areata, and Pitta burnout.
- [Patra Pinda Sweda (Elakizhi)](https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/patra-pinda-sweda-in-kharadi): Herbal bolus potli massage with medicinal leaves (Nirgundi, Eranda, Arka) fried in herbal oils for joint stiffness and arthritis.
- [Abhyanga & Swedana](https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/abhyanga-and-swedana-in-kharadi): Full-body warm medicated oil synchronization massage followed by individualized herbal steam box therapy for cellular detox.
- [Netra Tarpana Eye Care](https://vishwavedhikaayurveda.com/treatments/netra-tarpana-treatment-in-kharadi): Medicated herbal ghee pooling over the ocular orbits for computer vision syndrome, dry eyes, eye fatigue, and refractive strain.
